taxonomy.name: Variable Indirection & Dynamic Paths
taxonomy.description: Router methods invoked with variable identifiers rather than string literals (e.g., router.get(path, handler)).
taxonomy.mitigation: Intra-procedural symbolic scope evaluation resolving identifier bindings, template literals, and binary concatenation.

taxonomy.name: Multi-Router Star Re-Export Collision
taxonomy.description: Exporting multiple routers from index.ts causes sibling routers to cross-contaminate mount prefixes.
taxonomy.mitigation: Track prefix bindings by exact router identifier `${filePath}:${varName}` in SymbolicMountLinker.

taxonomy.name: Native File-Based Routing Omission
taxonomy.description: Assuming all frameworks use explicit router.method() calls, missing file-based dispatchers or native scripts.
taxonomy.mitigation: Classifier detects native directory conventions or array dispatchers ($routes = [...]).

taxonomy.name: WASM Memory Leak on Early Exit
taxonomy.description: Tree-sitter CST parser tree not deleted if function returns early or throws.
taxonomy.mitigation: Mandatory try ... finally blocks wrapping tree.delete().
